license_note: Google provides Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview as a managed service under the Gemini API Additional Terms of Service, which incorporate the Google APIs Terms of Service. The terms permit customer applications but prohibit developing competing models and reverse engineering, extracting, or replicating model components such as parameter weights, so nothing is licensed for self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Access to Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, including the incorporated Google APIs Terms of Service; no weight license

access_boundary: This record represents the preview release identified by the model code gemini-3.1-pro-preview (latest update February 2026; inputs text, image, video, audio, PDF; output text), together with its customtools endpoint variant for custom-tool-heavy agentic workflows. No shutdown date is announced and no stable successor ID exists. The retired gemini-3-pro-preview predecessor, the stable Flash line, image and audio-only releases, the Gemini consumer app, and the Vertex AI and AI Studio platforms themselves are separate model, service, or application boundaries.
strengths: Google documents a distinct preview model code plus a customtools endpoint variant, full modality matrix, token limits, and release date
The deprecations table and changelog record the predecessor shutdown and the alias switch in writing
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
Seven months in preview with only a two-week deprecation guarantee and no committed shutdown or general-availability date
